finding.title: the rotation delay protects PqOnly users only if they can prove within it
finding.plan: archive the v6.1.0 circuit artifacts by hash and keep a self-hosted proving path before real value
finding.dependency: Groth16 proof generation for circuit v6.1.0 needs Succinct's v6.1.0 circuit artifacts (about 6.21 GB) or the Succinct prover network; integrity is checked on chain by the pinned verifier key, availability is not WalletWall's.

basis: the circuit v6.1.0 Groth16 artifacts are absent on developer-workstation: ~/.sp1/circuits/groth16/v6.1.0 does not exist, nor does ~/.sp1/circuits
no WalletWall archive of them is recorded (evidence/zk/sp1-impl/proving-archives holds no record)
obtaining them needs the download of v6.1.0-groth16.tar.gz (about 6.21 GB, per SP1-TD1), which this lane is not authorized to make
upstream (sp1-circuits.s3-us-east-2.amazonaws.com) hosting them is not availability: it can stop, and nothing here relies on what it serves

known offline: their groth16_vk.bin must have sha256 0x4388a21c687fdd5f218d7e3d13190cac4c5355818d3605fd5fb811df468ee696 (492 bytes), the key sp1-verifier 6.3.1 embeds; that crate is the one zkvm/host/Cargo.lock pins, and the hash is the designated VERIFIER_HASH

members.knownFrom: sp1-verifier 6.3.1 vk-artifacts/groth16_vk.bin (crate sha256 b6dbb411abb1ea167f9b0b082c95f62ede26ab7ba72349770292a60dc0e9a673, the zkvm/host/Cargo.lock checksum)
members.role: the verifying key: a proof's selector and vkey hash are its sha256, so a proof made under any other key is refused by the designated verifier
read by Groth16 proving: any other file yields proofs the designated verifier refuses (liveness, never soundness)

pinnedProver: uses an existing directory as it is, and downloads https://sp1-circuits.s3-us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v6.1.0-groth16.tar.gz only when the directory is absent
checks no digest of the download, and extracts it with tar -Pxzf (absolute member names are kept)
$SP1_CIRCUIT_MODE=dev switches to development artifacts from another source
Groth16 proving reads constraints.json, groth16_circuit.bin, groth16_pk.bin; the proof's vkey hash is the sha256 of groth16_vk.bin

the host's dependency graph leaves sp1-recursion-gnark-ffi's native feature off, so the gnark prover runs in docker: ghcr.io/succinctlabs/sp1-gnark:v6.1.0 (a tag, mutable) unless $SP1_GNARK_IMAGE names another image

requirements: archive v6.1.0-groth16.tar.gz once, from an owner-authorized download, with its sha256 and every member's sha256 and size; upstream hosting is no archive

accept it only if its groth16_vk.bin has sha256 0x4388a21c687fdd5f218d7e3d13190cac4c5355818d3605fd5fb811df468ee696 and is byte-identical to sp1-verifier 6.3.1's vk-artifacts/groth16_vk.bin; the other members are checked by proving, never trusted
mirror the verified archive to at least two WalletWall-controlled locations, each recorded with the tarball's sha256
pin the gnark prover by digest: set $SP1_GNARK_IMAGE to ghcr.io/succinctlabs/sp1-gnark@sha256:<digest> and archive that image, since ghcr.io/succinctlabs/sp1-gnark:v6.1.0 is a mutable tag

prove only from the archive: place the verified members at $SP1_GROTH16_CIRCUIT_PATH/v6.1.0 (the pinned prover then downloads nothing), keep $SP1_CIRCUIT_MODE unset, and check every member's sha256 before each proving session (the prover checks none)

exercise it: one Groth16 proof of the designated program made with network egress off (no prover network, no sp1-circuits.s3-us-east-2.amazonaws.com), accepted by the designated verifier on every supported chain (the per-chain check with that proof), with its peak memory and wall time recorded against the 2-day rotation delay

ownerAction: authorize the download of v6.1.0-groth16.tar.gz (about 6.21 GB) and of the gnark image by digest; this lane downloaded nothing
name the two archive locations WalletWall controls
authorize the self-hosted proving run: a real proof, which this lane did not generate
notEstablished: the tarball's sha256 and the digests of constraints.json, groth16_circuit.bin, groth16_pk.bin (never downloaded)
that the self-hosted path proves at all, on what hardware, and within the 2-day rotation delay
